## 1. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

**Date of Agreement:** June 24, 2024

**Borrower/Company Overview:** Greystone Housing Impact Investors LP, a Delaware limited partnership formerly known as America First Multifamily Investors, L.P.

**Transaction Description:** Fourth Amendment to Amended and Restated Credit Agreement between Greystone Housing Impact Investors LP (Borrower) and Bankers Trust Company (Bank). **Purpose of Financing:** The revolving loan facility is used exclusively for acquisition of Financed Assets, specifically: (i) taxable or tax-exempt mortgage revenue bonds, (ii) taxable or tax-exempt loans financing affordable housing acquisition, rehabilitation, or construction, or (iii) taxable or tax-exempt loans secured by master lease agreements guaranteed by Investment Grade Tenants.

**Company Background:** The Borrower operates in the affordable housing finance sector, investing in mortgage revenue bonds and loans that support affordable housing development and acquisition. The company recently changed its name from America First Multifamily Investors, L.P. to Greystone Housing Impact Investors LP.

---

**Key Strengths/Credit Positives:**
• Specialized focus on affordable housing finance sector with clear investment criteria
• Established banking relationship with Bankers Trust Company dating back to 2021
• Recent extension demonstrates continued bank support and confidence in the credit
• Borrower represents no current Events of Default or Unmatured Events of Default
• Option for additional one-year extension available under existing terms

**Principal Risks:**
• **Concentration Risk:** Limited to affordable housing and related real estate investments
• **Credit Risk:** Exposure to underlying borrowers in affordable housing sector
• **Regulatory Risk:** Dependence on tax-exempt bond markets and government housing programs
• **Liquidity Risk:** Short-term advances (45 days) required for Investment Grade Tenant loans may create refinancing pressure
